<item name="engine" type="table{VehicleParamsEngine}">See <page>Structures/VehicleParamsEngine</page></item>
<item name="steering" type="table{VehicleParamsSteering}">See <page>Structures/VehicleParamsSteering</page></item>
	</fields>

</structure>
